review: Independent complete bounded lexical-extension pre-repair Code discovery
discovery: complete for the named lexical extension responsibilities and its explicit source accounts; repairs not implemented, broader native/generated/numerical/owner graph remains incomplete
verdict: Three connected source-backed current defects remain open. One shared GPU lexical owner is appropriate, subject to all source-pairing, intentional lowering, ambiguity and preservation criteria. No source/global/compile/hosted clearance.

findings.contract: A named algorithm declaration must be selected from actual native tokens, not comment text.
findings.scenario: All five regexes apply captures directly to original source. A leading complete commented signature can provide different parameters/output than the real following declaration; role bindings, call arguments, output types and native resource declarations are then generated from the comment. Missing declarations can also be admitted from comments alone.
findings.repair: All five consume the single GPU FunctionSource selection/header/argument/return authority; no private schema regex selects fn declarations from whole source afterward.

findings.contract: The rewrite must target the same declaration that supplied the admitted roles.
findings.scenario: A leading comment containing only fn gather(decoy) is ignored by the full signature regex (no body brace), but selected by the shorter rewrite regex. A following real gather with a Resource parameter is correctly parsed but never stripped, so generated WGSL retains an invalid metadata type. Scatter/Stream and non-neighborhood Stencil have the same independent shorter-selector structure.
findings.repair: Rewrite only the admitted argument span from that same FunctionSource owner. Do not independently search the original source again, and preserve all bytes outside intentional header/type substitutions.

findings.status: confirmed current actionable connected admission defect
findings.contract: NativeParameter roles must derive from visible tokens while retaining their exact original source association.
findings.scenario: The raw argument splitter treats punctuation inside comments as angle depth, argument commas and name/type colons. For example, a valid native comment containing a colon between the parameter identifier and real colon becomes InvalidParameter rather than the actual index/value role. Inline type comments also interfere with exact coordinate/resource/offset classification.
findings.repair: Consume paired original and same-byte visible argument slices from the lexical owner; split/classify using visible tokens and derive each original declaration/type/name range from the same offsets. Preserve original diagnostics and declarations rather than substituting the masked source into shaders.

design_acceptance_obligations.contract: A retained declaration ending in // must keep a real line terminator before the comma or closing parenthesis.
design_acceptance_obligations.reason: Current trim and join(", ") can discard the only newline after a line comment. Once visible-token role lexing admits such valid source, copying a trimmed raw declaration can comment out generated delimiters. Preserve sufficient original trivia or use safe newline separators, without mutating body/comment text outside the admitted span.

design_acceptance_obligations.contract: Retain successful real Neighbors type-envelope uses beyond the selected stencil header.
design_acceptance_obligations.reason: Current replace_all rewrites every real matching NeighborsND<T> occurrence when a neighborhood is present. Helper function parameters/returns, local or global type annotations and constructor uses of the admitted neighborhood type can therefore succeed today. Replacing only the selected argument type would leave unsupported pseudo-generic types in those sources. Use the same comment-aware source/span authority for intentional real reserved-type substitutions; preserve comments and all unrelated source bytes. Do not invent a narrower source restriction without an existing authoritative contract.

design_acceptance_obligations.contract: Real duplicate target names must remain rejected.
design_acceptance_obligations.reason: Renaming only one declaration or stripping only one duplicate header can turn formerly invalid duplicate declarations into valid separate declarations. The FunctionSource selection must explicitly reject an ambiguous real named declaration set; never choose silently. Same native/comment source identity applies to all seven named protocols.

design_acceptance_obligations.contract: Mask and original source must have identical byte lengths with admitted UTF-8 slice boundaries.
design_acceptance_obligations.reason: Native WGSL consumes nested block comments and line endings U+000A..000D, U+0085, U+2028/U+2029. Pattern blankspace additionally includes U+200E/U+200F. One canonical lexical owner handles these; no second per-algorithm scanner. Original source remains the only emitted authored text.

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: The GPU lexical owner must reach binary/comparison helpers, all five schema parsers, NativeParameter and every argument/type rewrite, while public definitions/execute/build always use the current public code field.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: GPU signature; source_parameter; Map/Gather/Scatter/Stream/Stencil entrypoints and private programs

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: Byte spans and fixed grammar punctuation are native source metadata. std byte ranges are appropriate privately; do not reuse GPU buffer offsets or add a competing count/stride owner. Existing NeighborhoodDimension owns 1..4 dimensions.

One selected native name is authoritative; GeneratedFunction names retain actual algorithm protocol/error messages. Reserved index/size/offset/center/val/resource names retain their semantic role precedence.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: all five signature role matches, GeneratedFunction::name and prior native operator error

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: Keep ResourceBaseType, ShaderParameter, CoordinateParameter/Shape, NeighborhoodParameter and typed GeneratedProgramError. NativeParameter/SourceParameter should consume lexical slices, not introduce a second type grammar or erase original declarations.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: complete source_parameter, signature and neighborhood owners

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: Original borrow, same-length visible mask, unique name/header/argument/return spans and selected declaration form one private immutable admitted source. Each NativeParameter pairs original declaration with the role derived from its visible slice.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: source_parameter.rs and all five SourceParameter::new sites

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: Real function token/declaration selection ignores complete native comments, rejects ambiguous names and preserves MissingFunction/MissingReturn/InvalidParameter/coordinate/native error ownership. No earlier full Naga parsing of pseudo-types or generated-context globals.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: fresh parsers and pinned Naga lexer

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: Rewrites consume admitted spans, preserve UTF-8 boundaries and line-comment terminators, and apply multiple edits without offset drift or overlapping replacements. Emit original retained declarations and intended real neighborhood aliases only.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: four rewrites, NativeParameter trim, stencil replace_all

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: No raw whole-source fn regex remains in schemas or programs. A build operation selects once and routes that authority to role parsing and transformation; contextual bindings stay derived from current source/resource recipe. Definition admission and later builds may reselect current mutable code at their separate existing boundaries.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: definition/build/cache/execute bodies, signature parsers and independent rewrite regexes

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: Keep ordered Index/Size/Value/Resource and fieldless Other/Offset/Center cases with existing real payloads. Do not collapse source association into semantic booleans or reintroduce independently mutable declarations/roles.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: five private role enums and SourceParameter

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: FunctionSource is a lexical relationship owner, not an all-purpose WGSL validator. Keep algorithm semantic schemas owned by Compute and native value/coordinate grammar at existing owners; do not add unrelated supported features.

GPU owns one native lexical selection/mask responsibility usable by Compute without a dependency cycle. Compute owns semantic role admission/rewrite policy. Parent reports peer API agreement received; reviewer makes no source edit.

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: Existing derived Eq/Hash on owned schemas and canonical payloads should remain semantically equivalent if storage changes. Prior D2 proof remains valid for Error-only derive, with exact manual Display/source(None) and no new GPU dependency.

thirteen_lens_dispositions.contract: Preserve source-order arguments, explicit-index priority, Stream optional input/offset behavior, Stencil center/val/fallback, Custom types, exact shader math/resources/workgroups/signed-neighborhood bounds, success-only caches and current error order. Do not expand the unsupported neighbor+secondary Buffer path or introduce a new feature promise.
thirteen_lens_dispositions.source: fresh private programs/callers plus exact prior neighborhood/layout/fixture source

acceptance: One GPU FunctionSource lexical owner borrows original source and owns exactly one same-byte visible comment mask; all admitted source spans are private, tied to that source and immutable. No second comment scanner/parser in Compute.

Canonical selection recognizes actual fn/name tokens, native comment trivia and unique real named declaration, not search hits in comments or longer identifiers. Binary and comparison helpers consume it; ComparisonSignature parse/value_type/renamed_source remains the agreed public comparison relationship.

All five signatures parse that owner’s argument/header/optional-return views. NativeParameter consumes original/visible paired views, classifies only visible tokens, preserves original declaration and typed original diagnostic payloads, and retains source-order roles.

Gather/Scatter/Stream/non-neighborhood Stencil rewrite the same admitted argument span, never perform another raw fn regex search, and preserve every authored byte outside intentional replacements. Retained line comments cannot consume generated separators/closing syntax.

Stencil neighborhood lowering reuses the same lexical/source association for real matching reserved-type envelopes, including existing successful helper signatures, local/global type annotations and constructor uses. Comment text and all unrelated body/global text remain exact; generated alias spelling comes from the admitted neighborhood/type owner, not a competing raw regex projection.

Duplicate real target names reject explicitly; singular edits cannot silently convert invalid duplicate declarations into valid differently named functions. Multiple intended source edits must avoid offset drift and overlap.

No full Naga parse moves ahead of generated metadata lowering or context binding, because Resource/Neighbors pseudo-types and generated globals make standalone source parsing inappropriate. Native shader/pipeline errors retain actual causes and occur at existing actual admission boundaries.

Preserve MissingFunction/MissingReturn/InvalidParameter/DuplicateParameter and CoordinateParameter native causes, NativeOperatorSignatureError roles/Display, malformed/unsupported neighborhood policy and settled unit role cases. Do not broaden numeric/source grammar merely to close lexical selection.

All public definitions retain current-code recipe/cache identity and success-only publication. Input/output/workgroup/packing/count/stride/native progress behavior stays unchanged; remaining owner integration cannot be called cleared.

Existing five-family fixtures, literals, values, cases, helpers and assertions remain unchanged. No new tests/cases/helpers/assertions/probes; do not claim coverage for absent Scatter or lexical-comment fixtures.
Read-only pre-repair inventory only. Root complete all13/three independent reviews, connected owner integration and final same-pushed-SHA hosted/baseline gates remain required.
